rationale:
Step 700. Observation: mass is decodable at the value token (kappa 0.6) and the three units share
one block geometry (per-unit CKA 0.99), but nothing is causal yet (block IIA 0.16) and accuracy is at
chance-level for the task (0.25). From the pilot we know that at steps 900-1,000 the code becomes
causal and unit 1's route splits off (interaction 0.05-0.2 -> 0.45 -> 0.66), after which no small
edit can undo it.

Hypothesis: the split arises because the readout learns to use unit-specific patterns. If, while the
shared geometry still exists, we make the network USE the block additively (translating the block by
class-mean differences changes the answer accordingly), the shared code may become the causal one.

Method: constrained optimization (loop_edits/common.mean_translation_edit) over the attention and MLP
weights, 200 Adam steps on FIT, with KL and task terms to preserve behaviour; scaled to <= 8% of the
model norm. Target: block IIA(M) (the representation becomes causal in the block).

Step 1,000 (mass just became causal: block IIA 0.65; unit 1 has split off: unit 0-1 CKA 0.52,
interaction 0.45 and rising; 84% of the interaction is written by layer-2 attention heads 0/2).

Method (bespoke, loop_edits/common.organize_edit): optimize the attention and MLP weights for 300
Adam steps on FIT to minimise a DIFFERENTIABLE mass x route interaction share of the block (two-way
cell decomposition, residual-maker on the cell design), while keeping the original predictions
(KL x30), the block's causal sufficiency (block-interchange CE) and a relative L2 leash.
Route (unit x position) MAIN effects are not penalized, so unit information stays in the block.

Why now: OBS pre-checks on the control's future showed the same method at 1,200-1,500 removes more
interaction but costs 0.04-0.12 held-out-combination accuracy; at 1,000-1,100 it is nearly free.
OBS pre-check here: interaction -0.14, keep 0.993, acc +0.02, IIA +0.08, OOD_DEV -0.007, edit +0.012.
Target: interaction (decrease >= 0.02 with editability not falling).

Second submission at this checkpoint (the w_inter=2 version failed S2 0.979 and editability -0.003 on VAL):
half the interaction weight. OBS pre-check: interaction -0.07, keep 0.997, IIA +0.10, OOD_DEV +0.001.
Target: interaction (decrease >= 0.02 with editability not falling).

Step 1,100 (accuracy 0.95, block IIA 0.83, interaction 0.50, unit 0-1 CKA 0.55; 89% of the
interaction written by attn2).

Same bespoke method as at 1,000 (organize_edit: differentiable interaction penalty, KL to original
predictions, block interchange, L2 leash) with a stronger KL (x60) because at 1,000 the VAL keep-rate
was the binding constraint. OBS pre-check: interaction -0.10, unit-transfer ratio +0.039, keep 0.995,
accuracy +0.002, IIA +0.018, OOD_DEV -0.003, editability -0.004.
Target: unit_transfer (the mass code learned on two units reads correctly on the third), the
organizational property I am trying to create; editability is NOT claimed here.

Step 1,500 (after the collapse at 1,200 and full recovery: accuracy 0.999, block IIA 0.94; the
network re-formed the control's organization -- interaction 0.63, unit 1 split (CKA 0.36), pooled
editability 0.06; organization is frozen from here, learning rate decaying).

Post-formation, shrinking the interaction costs held-out accuracy (OBS pre-checks), so I target
editability directly. Bespoke method (loop_edits/common.rewire_edit), 400 Adam steps on FIT over all
attention + MLP weights:
  * translation term: shifting the block by class-mean differences mu[pi(M)] - mu[M] must produce
    the answer for pi(M), for RANDOM class permutations pi (never inversion or add-one: inversion is
    the gate target, add-one is the held-out final test);
  * KL x30 to the original predictions (behaviour) and block-interchange CE (causal sufficiency);
  * noise-KL x10: the original readout's outputs on noise-perturbed block activations are kept
    (function preserved OFF the data manifold, where held-out unit-value combinations land; without
    it OOD_DEV fell 0.13);
  * route_keep x5: a frozen probe of route (unit x position), fitted on the original block, must still
    read the edited block (without it route information fell 0.04-0.06, violating S5);
  * L2 leash; the learned delta is then scaled by 0.4 (editability gain is superlinear in scale;
    0.4 is the largest scale whose OBS pre-check kept OOD_DEV within tolerance with margin).
OBS pre-check: editability +0.070, keep 1.000, acc 0.000, IIA -0.004, OOD_DEV 0.000, wrong +0.014,
route info +0.19, unit info +0.02. Target: edit_inv.
